 Seventeen’s Junghan, Joshua cinch ‘gold’ in Japan
 Published : Nov. 11, 2026 - 10:58:11
 Add The Korea Herald on Google
 Link copied!
 Hwang You-mee 
 Subscribe + 
 (Pledis Entertainment) 
 The first mini album released by Junghan and Joshua of Seventeen was certified gold by the Recording Industry Association of Japan in October, the organization said Wednesday.
 The duo’s first EP, released last month, has logged over 100,000 shipments and topped Oricon’s Daily, Weekly and Weekly Combined Album Rankings. “Dreamscape” has also topped Billboard Japan’s Top Album Sales Chart.
 The two idols are readying for a dome concert in Saitama, Japan, slated for Nov. 21-22. The show on the 22nd will be screened at cinemas across Japan and at a string of major cities worldwide, from Seoul to Singapore and Mexico City.
 The Japan gig will be followed by concerts in Macao, Taipei in Taiwan, Busan in Korea, and Hong Kong.
